# Comprehensive Feature Readiness Checklist: Financial Resilience & Decision Ecosystem

**Purpose**: Pre-implementation requirements quality validation for the integrated Installments, Emergency Fund Shield, Smart Savings Goals, and Financial Sandbox Engine.  
**Created**: 2026-09-22  
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md)  

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.  
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.  
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.  

---

## 1. Financial Calculations & Accounting Integrity

- [x] CHK001 - Are essential monthly burn rate calculation components (bills, recurring commitments, installments, baseline living spend) explicitly defined and quantified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Plan §Summary]
- [x] CHK002 - Is the Debt-to-Income (DTI) ratio threshold of 40% testable and linked to concrete warning state definitions? [Measurability, Spec §FR-003, Spec §US-1]
- [x] CHK003 - Are the discrete-event simulation time horizons (3, 6, 12 months) and step intervals (daily vs. monthly) unambiguously specified for trajectory projections? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013, Research §4]
- [x] CHK004 - Is the conservative hybrid model for variable daily spending (higher of active category budgets and 60-day historical average) specified with exact mathematical selection rules? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, Clarification 3]
- [x] CHK005 - Can the recovery runway calculation (`Cash Outflow / Daily Savings Rate`) be objectively verified when the user's net monthly savings rate is zero or negative? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-017, Research §4]
- [x] CHK006 - Are the criteria for classifying decision feasibility into "Safe & Recommended", "Viable with Caution", and "Critical Risk" mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015, Data Model §4]

---

## 2. UI/UX, Glassmorphism & Mobile Interaction

- [x] CHK007 - Are visual and interaction requirements specified for the third "Installments" tab in the Debts screen? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Plan §Project Structure]
- [x] CHK008 - Are progress bar visual metrics (`paidMonths / totalMonths`) and countdown formats consistently defined across all installment cards? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Contracts §installments-api]
- [x] CHK009 - Is the visual hierarchy of the "Financial Shield" widget on the Dashboard quantified with respect to existing balance and cash flow metrics? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Plan §Project Structure]
- [x] CHK010 - Are Recharts trajectory graph requirements (dual area gradient fill, emergency safety floor threshold, point tooltips) defined without omitting empty/single-month states? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013, Plan §Project Structure]
- [x] CHK011 - Are modal dialogs across Installments, Goal creation, and Commit Confirmation explicitly required to render via document body portal to prevent z-index stacking bugs? [Coverage, Spec §FR-023, Constitution §VI]
- [x] CHK012 - Are localization requirements and RTL directional behaviors defined for all new financial metrics, charts, and toast notifications? [Completeness, Spec §FR-022, Constitution §VI]

---

## 3. API Contracts, Data Integrity & Offline Synchronization

- [x] CHK013 - Are endpoint request and response schemas completely documented for all 12 feature routes across Installments, Emergency Fund, Savings Goals, and Sandbox? [Completeness, Contracts §all]
- [x] CHK014 - Is the dual-mode installment payment processing sequence (automated detection on due date with manual one-tap fallback) specified with clear priority order and notification triggers? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Clarification 2]
- [x] CHK015 - Are atomic rollback requirements defined for the "Commit to Reality" endpoint in the event of partial document creation failure? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020, Constitution §I]
- [x] CHK016 - Are client-side Dexie IndexedDB schema migration and offline caching requirements documented for new `installments` and `savingsGoals` tables? [Coverage, Plan §Technical Context, Constitution §V]

---

## 4. Edge Cases & Boundary Handling

- [x] CHK017 - Are requirements specified for handling zero-income or complete income loss scenarios during Sandbox simulation? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Research §4]
- [x] CHK018 - Is the system behavior specified when a user attempts to over-fund or deposit beyond 100% of a savings goal target? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Data Model §3]
- [x] CHK019 - Does the specification define calendar handling when an installment due date falls on the 29th, 30th, or 31st of a month with fewer days (e.g., February)? [Edge Case, Gap, Data Model §1]
- [x] CHK020 - Are fallback requirements defined for offline simulation runs when the client cannot fetch fresh cloud transaction snapshots? [Edge Case, Coverage, Spec §SC-005]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference (CHK001–CHK020).
